name: Internet & cloud outages
value: Microsoft 365 outage ran past 27h on 13 Nov
summary: Microsoft's 365 outage that began on 12 Nov stretched past 27 hours on 13 Nov, hitting Exchange email and Intune
state: The Microsoft 365 disruption that took down Exchange Online email and Intune for organisations worldwide from 12 Nov stretched past 27 hours on 13 Nov as successive fixes failed (The Register, 12 and 13 Nov). Searches on 14 Nov found no confirmed restoration time, so a major cloud outage of more than 2 hours falls within the past 48 hours. No effect on payments or emergency services was reported, so this is Watch, not Alert.
for_you: Organisations relying on Microsoft 365 email and device management are most exposed; Microsoft's service health page reports restoration progress. Outages of this kind tend to leave delayed mail and sign-in problems for some hours afterwards.
rubric_hit: Major cloud outage > 2h within past 48h (Microsoft 365, 27h+ from 12 Nov) = Watch

sources.title: The Register — Microsoft's massive M365 outage stretches past 27 hours as its fixes keep failing
The Register — Microsoft struggling to fix massive cloud outage that's taken down email and Intune

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
